title: Lead Client Partner, Consumer Apps (tvScientific)
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 About tvScientific by Pinterest
 We are the first CTV advertising platform purpose-built for performance marketers. For brands and app developers, we bridge the gap between massive TV reach and granular User Acquisition (UA) metrics. Built by ad-tech veterans, our platform combines media buying, optimization, and MMP attribution to help consumer brands automate CTV campaigns, drive app installs, and maximize Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
 As a Lead Client Partner, you’ll leverage your experience in performance marketing and digital advertising to champion the value of our product, empowering brands, companies, and agencies to achieve their advertising objectives through the power of CTV. title: Business Value Scale Analyst
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Business Value Consulting team focuses on driving long-term growth and value creation for Stripe's largest and most strategic users. The team quantifies the financial and strategic impact of Stripe's platform (from revenue optimization to operational efficiency) and translates that into the business cases that underpin Stripe's largest and most complex deals. We help drive meaningful business outcomes and accelerate decision-making through a consultative approach that aims to build investment confidence and elevate CxO conversations.
 The Business Value Scale Analyst joins at a moment when the BVC team is expanding its impact across Stripe’s broader GTM organization through systematic programs, financial modeling, thought leadership, and data-driven insights. Work product by the Business Value Scale Analyst will directly influence Stripe’s most consequential deals.
 What you'll do
 The Business Value Scale Analyst is a new role that requires intellectual curiosity, judgment, proactivity, analytical rigor, and strong communication skills. They partner closely with the broader team to design and operationalize programmatic tooling, economic frameworks, data-driven financial models, and user-facing presentations that deal teams will deploy in Stripe’s most complex and high-stakes customer conversations.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo
 RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.
   As our Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d), you act as the electrical core of our robotics engineering team, taking complete ownership of our hardware platforms from early prototyping through to series production. You bridge high-speed autonomous robotic development with robust engineering processes, ensuring our hardware meets the highest quality and safety standards, and set up efficient systems and engineering gates that empower the broader team to work with clarity, focus, and speed.
 Your Responsibilities
 Own the full electrical picture: Design and execute schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, cable harness design, connector selection, and part specification.
 Drive end-to-end prototyping and series production: Build PCBs, circuits, and wiring systems, taking dynamic initial concepts all the way through to scalable manufacturing.
 Establish engineering processes: Build standard QA frameworks, engineering gates, and operational systems that allow the team to stay focused, execute rapidly, and succeed.
 Ensure quality, compliance, and safety: Act as the primary gatekeeper for electrical quality while navigating applicable industry safety standards and regulatory compliance.
 Engine for high-speed execution: Balance fast-paced autonomous robotic iteration with pragmatic, right-sized QA processes tailored to current development stages.
 Design motion system architectures: Develop and optimize 24V/48V power distribution, motor/servo drive integration, and sensor interfaces to ensure high signal integrity and thermal efficiency.
